subject: Media Literacy
title: Nostalgia in Advertising
description: A fast breakdown of Nostalgia in Advertising for builders.

hook.text: Coca-Cola's holiday ads make you feel warm inside — even though you're watching a commercial for sugar water.

buildup.text: Nostalgia advertising links products to positive memories — childhood, holidays, simpler times.

discovery.text: Nostalgia triggers a neurological response. It literally warms you, reducing your critical defenses.

twist.text: The memories aren't real. They're idealized versions of the past manufactured to sell you something now.

climax.text: When an ad makes you feel sentimental, your wallet is about to open.

punchline.text: They don't sell the past. They sell your longing for it.

quiz.question: Why is nostalgia effective in advertising?
options: It triggers warm feelings that reduce critical thinking
People only buy things they remember
